info.title: Cardia engine
info.summary: Local analysis engine for the Cardia app. Listens on 127.0.0.1 only.

get.description: Whether the engine is up. The only route that needs no token.
Versions, model files, methods and image layers. Use it to check the token works.
Jobs since the engine started, newest first.

post.description:
Upload scans and start analysing them. Poll GET /jobs/{job_id} for progress.

Problems with a single file (unsupported type, too large, duplicate) fail that slice, not the job.
Each slice that is done is filed into the library heart with its heart ID.

get.description: A job's state and every slice's progress.

post.description: Stop a job: slices not yet started are cancelled; slices already running finish and are kept.

get.description: Every stored slice result, newest first.
One slice's numbers, QC flags, versions and layer names.

A layer image. Fetch it with the token header and show it through URL.createObjectURL.

Results never change, so the response may be cached for good.
Library hearts, most recently changed first.

get.description: One heart: details, slices in order, and its numbers.

patch.description: Change experiment details, tags, favourite, slice order or typed weights. Only fields sent change.

delete.description: Move a heart to the trash. It can be restored for 30 days.

post.description: Take a heart out of the trash.
Heart numbers from any slices (PLAN.md §2g). Weights typed by the user override the file names'.

get.description: One row per library heart (the same filters as GET /hearts; never the trash).
One row per slice of a heart, apex to base. Only the ranges reports show are included.
The Methods paragraph for each method, the headline method (Settings) first. English.

Everything about a heart in one ZIP: original scans, results, image layers, CSVs, the Methods
paragraph, settings, and a manifest with the SHA-256 of every file.

The hearts the pipeline was checked on, with each method's infarct %, as context for a report.
Compare a heart with them only when its pipeline version and model files are the same.

The demo heart: one study heart's real scans, bundled so the walkthrough works with no data of
your own. 404 in a build without the data folder.
One scan of the demo heart, byte for byte as it is in the study set.

The whole library as one ZIP: every heart and its details, every slice result and image layer,
every original scan, and a manifest with the SHA-256 of each file. Restore it with POST
/library/restore, here or on another computer.

200.description: The whole library in one file

post.description:
Add a backup's hearts to this library. Nothing here is overwritten: hearts already here are
skipped, and a damaged backup is refused before anything changes.

400.description: Not a Cardia backup, or a damaged one

DemoHeart.title: DemoHeart
DemoHeart.description:
The demo heart for the walkthrough (PLAN.md §1h): real scans of one study heart, bundled with the
engine. Fetch each scan from GET /demo/{name} and import it like any other.

name.title: Name
name.description: The file name, which gives the heart ID and the slice weight

mock.title: Mock
mock.description: True when the engine runs the fake analysis for UI work (numbers are made up)

heart_key.title: Heart Key
heart_key.description: The library's ID for this heart

deleted_at.title: Deleted At
deleted_at.description: Set while the heart is in the trash

purge_after.title: Purge After
purge_after.description: When a heart in the trash is removed for good (30 days)

summary.description: Heart numbers; null without slices, or when they come from different pipeline versions

position.title: Position
position.description: Order in the heart, from 0 (apex to base when the user has ordered them)

weight_mg.title: Weight Mg
weight_mg.description: The typed weight, else the file name's

weight_mg.title: Weight Mg
weight_mg.description: Overrides the weight from the file name

weight_mg.title: Weight Mg
weight_mg.description: A typed weight; null uses the file name's

weighting.title: Weighting
weighting.description: Slice percentages are weighted by slice weight, or by tissue area when any weight is missing

method_b.description: Null when any slice was analysed before pipeline 0.6.0 (no DBSCAN + RF)

method_c.description: Null when any slice was analysed before pipeline 0.5.0 (no stain ratio)

heart_id.title: Heart Id
heart_id.description: Defaults to the first slice's heart_id

HeartUpdate.title: HeartUpdate
HeartUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent change. `slices` is the heart's new slice list, in order; slices left out are
taken out of the heart (their results are kept).

state.title: State
state.description: done: every slice is done or failed. cancelled: cancel was asked; slices already running finish

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: While running: the step in progress

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: The result already existed, so nothing was re-analysed

heart_key.title: Heart Key
heart_key.description: Set when the job has finished: the library heart it was filed into

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: Analysis time in seconds (null if cached or not finished)

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: photo: RGB PNG. mask: PNG that is white where true and transparent elsewhere (tint it with CSS mask-image). heatmap: RGBA PNG, viridis colour map from p = 0 (dark blue) to 1 (yellow), transparent outside the tissue.

LearnProgressDoc-Input.description: The Learn section's progress, kept by the engine so it can sync (the app merges before sending).

LearnProgressDoc-Output.title: LearnProgressDoc
LearnProgressDoc-Output.description: The Learn section's progress, kept by the engine so it can sync (the app merges before sending).

dead_pct.title: Dead Pct

dead_mg.title: Dead Mg
dead_mg.description: dead_pct x slice weight; null without a weight

many_unsure.title: Many Unsure
many_unsure.description: More than 15% of the tissue is unsure

dead_pct.title: Dead Pct
dead_pct.description: Dead share of the shared tissue: p >= 0.5 (DBSCAN + RF forest)

dead_mg.title: Dead Mg
dead_mg.description: dead_pct x slice weight; null without a weight

many_unsure.title: Many Unsure
many_unsure.description: More than 15% of the tissue is unsure

dead_pct.title: Dead Pct
dead_pct.description: Dead share of the shared tissue: less than half the red stain of living muscle, leaning cream

borderline_pct.title: Borderline Pct
borderline_pct.description: Between 40% and 60% of the living stain

name.title: Name
name.description: Label to show, e.g. "Method A: K-Means + RF"

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Methods A and B learn from the photos (compared side by side); Method C is a colour rule

unsure_rule.title: Unsure Rule
unsure_rule.description: Methods A and B: unsure tissue; Method C: borderline tissue

range_shown.title: Range Shown
range_shown.description: Whether reports show this method's range (PLAN.md §2g)

text.title: Text
text.description: English. For demo (--mock) results, a warning instead of a paragraph

MethodsParagraph.title: MethodsParagraph
MethodsParagraph.description: A Methods paragraph for one method (PLAN.md §1d): what was done, with versions and model hashes.

shown.title: Shown
shown.description: Show this range in reports. Method C shows its range; Methods A and B hide theirs (PLAN.md §2g)

hearts_skipped.title: Hearts Skipped
hearts_skipped.description: Hearts already in this library (by key), or whose slices all are

RestoreReport.title: RestoreReport
RestoreReport.description: What a restore added. Restoring never overwrites: hearts already here are skipped.

slice_id.title: Slice Id
slice_id.description: Same image, file name, pipeline and models give the same slice_id

heart_id.title: Heart Id
heart_id.description: From names like 206IS89mg.tif; otherwise the file name without extension

weight_mg.title: Weight Mg
weight_mg.description: From the file name; null if it has none

dpi.title: Dpi
dpi.description: [x, y] from the image file; null if it has none

method_b.description: Method B, DBSCAN + RF (pipeline 0.6.0 on); null for results stored by an earlier pipeline

method_c.description: Method C, the stain ratio (pipeline 0.5.0 on, where it was called Method B); null for results stored by an earlier pipeline

filled_px.description: Enclosed gaps filled in as tissue (glare, very pale tissue)
